description: ROUND over a double precision argument returns double precision on PostgreSQL, not numeric

columns.name: rounded
columns.note: PostgreSQL's round(double precision) returns double precision, unlike round(numeric) which returns numeric

name: round_preserves_float_type
query_sql:
-- @name GetRoundedValue
-- @returns :many
SELECT ROUND(value) AS rounded FROM measurements
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE measurements (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, value DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL);
